subject: The Law of Beasts (Netflix)
query: is the law of beasts a true story
title: Is The Law of Beasts a true story? Yes, Poland's real 'Beast Act' case
answer: Yes. Netflix's The Law of Beasts (Prawo bestii), a four-part Polish drama premiering Nov. 18, 2026, is inspired by the real case of Mariusz Trynkiewicz, who was convicted of the 1988 murders of four boys in Piotrków Trybunalski. His planned release in 2014 led Poland to pass a law nicknamed the "Beast Act."
body:
The series, directed by Kasper Bajon and written by Bajon and Anna Kasińska, moves between two timelines. In 1988, investigator Major Anna Bersz (Agnieszka Grochowska) leads the hunt for the killer, while her friend, psychiatrist Agnieszka Grabska (Agnieszka Żulewska), must judge whether the suspect is sane. In 2014, the convicted man is about to walk free, and the two women have to face the decision that ended their friendship. Michał Pawlik plays Trynkiewicz. Netflix says the story is "inspired by" real events, so the two lead women should be treated as dramatized characters, not a documentary record.

The real case: Trynkiewicz received four death sentences for the killings. In 1989 an amnesty replaced them with 25 years in prison, so he was due to be released in February 2014. As that date approached, his release caused a national outcry.

The "Beast Act" (ustawa o bestiach) is the popular name of a law that took effect in January 2014 covering people with mental disorders who pose a threat to the life, health or sexual freedom of others. It lets a court order that such a person, after finishing a prison sentence, be held in a closed facility, the National Center for the Prevention of Dissocial Behavior in Gostynin, with the court reviewing the need for detention at least every six months. Trynkiewicz left prison on Feb. 11, 2014, and in March 2014 a court ordered him held in Gostynin. Human rights groups argued the law amounted to a second punishment, but Poland's Constitutional Tribunal ruled on Nov. 23, 2016, that its core was constitutional because the detention is a therapeutic and preventive measure, not a penalty. It struck down only the rule that let a single doctor's opinion decide a review.

Where is he now? Trynkiewicz is dead. He later received additional prison sentences for other offenses and died on Jan. 9, 2025, at age 62, in a prison hospital ward, according to Poland's Prison Service.

faq.q: Who plays Mariusz Trynkiewicz in The Law of Beasts?
faq.a: Michał Pawlik. Agnieszka Grochowska plays Major Anna Bersz and Agnieszka Żulewska plays psychiatrist Agnieszka Grabska.

faq.q: What is the Beast Act in Poland?
faq.a: The nickname of a law in force since January 2014 that lets courts keep dangerous people with mental disorders in a closed center in Gostynin after their prison terms end, with reviews at least every six months.
